label: implementation-summary.md is the packet file that documents the deep-research reducer's --artifact-dir flag, including its exit-1 decision and missing-value verification
A missing --artifact-dir value produces exit code 1: the reducer prints '[deep-research] --artifact-dir requires a path value' to stderr and calls process.exit(1)

spec.md is the requirement source, tasks.md the work record, and plan.md describes the plan; only implementation-summary.md documents the flag's missing-value behavior, so it is the packet file that answers the question

The missing-value guard also fires when the next token starts with --, so '--artifact-dir --lenient' exits 1, and the equals form --artifact-dir=<path> is ignored and falls back to the base research folder
